hebrewText: פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע וְ/כִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְ/אָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה וּ/פֶֽן אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְ/גָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝/תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽ/י

tokens.bdb: properly, removal; used only (in the construction) adverb as conjunction, lest
to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively)

tokens.kjv: deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-) lie, lying, submit selves.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"
